name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name (domain=play, descriptor=game_ending_cinematic). Accurately describes purpose: the top-level game-ending cinematic flow dispatched on current_chapter_id (0x1A BAD short ending vs GOOD full ending + 20-char credit roll). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Plays the whole game-ending cinematic; branches on data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id == 0x1A (BAD short ending, entered from chapter_27_end no-sky-key path) vs != 0x1A (GOOD full ending + 20-char credit roll, entered from chapter_30_end final-boss-kill path).
logic_summary: Copies three 20-byte per-duel credit-roll tables (top/bottom portrait ids, scripted-cinematic mode) to the stack; mallocs a 320KB scroll workspace + a 64000-byte VGA backup. Loads FDOTHER.DAT[0x36] character-endings atlas; shows title frame (frame 0), fade out/in, mid ANI seq 2, highlight frame 9 + fade-down. Runs three dialog-dispatch blocks each pivoting on current_chapter_id==0x1A (BAD vs GOOD portrait/dialog sets) interleaved with: 3x full palette fade, sprite cycling 0x0C..0x6C, a 0x28-iteration horizontal-scroll duel intro (off_down/off_up offsets), and a 200-iteration scroll with a trailing palette fade-out (frames > 0x87). Calls fd2_play_final_chapter_30_ending(). Then: BGM-transition image FDOTHER.DAT[0x3C] + credits BGM track 0x12; loads FDOTHER.DAT[0x3A] (credit-roll blit atlas) and FDOTHER.DAT[0x39] (assigned to the VGA palette-data global, freed after the loop). 20-char credit roll: per duel derive runtime_char[0]/[1] team (2 if portrait id < 0x4C else 0) + portrait id from the top/bottom tables, set the scripted-cinematic mode from the scripted table, run a pre-scripted duel via fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic(0,1), then show the credit sprite frame and fade. Finally loads/shows the final ending image FDOTHER.DAT[0x3B]. Both callers hard-lock (infinite loop) after this returns.

returns.semantics: No return value. Both callers (fd2_chapter_27_end, fd2_chapter_30_end) enter an infinite do-nothing loop immediately after this returns (game terminates here).

notes: Source comment block (aniend.c lines 444-486) is already accurate, comprehensive, and consistent with the decompilation and both callers (verified: chapter_27_end calls with id still 0x1A then infinite-loops; chapter_30_end increments id past 0x1A then infinite-loops -> the cinematic's id==0x1A branch is the BAD short path, else the GOOD full path).
